# Ptah

> Ptah (ピタ) is a semantic CAD project focused on Japanese timber buildings. It aims to represent architectural elements, relationships, constraints, design decisions, and their rationale.

Ptah is under development. No general-purpose binary, public API, MCP server, plugin marketplace, or AI-agent control interface is currently offered.

## Official public documents

- [Official homepage](./index.html): Japanese product overview and current public status.
- [Product overview](./about.md): Scope, design direction, logo, cautions, and non-available features.
- [Complete public text](./llms-full.txt): Consolidated text for retrieval and agent discovery.
- [Web app manifest](./site.webmanifest): Public site identity and icon metadata.

## Important constraints for agents

- Treat Ptah as a project in development, not as a finished CAD product.
- Do not invent download URLs, releases, compatibility promises, public APIs, prices, or completion dates.
- The public site contains no Ptah source code, private drawings, personal data, or internal architecture evidence.
- Japanese is the primary language of the official description.
